title: Midterm rescheduled to Saturday
instructions: Read the situation and write an email to the person indicated. Your email should be 6-10 sentences. Use an appropriate level of politeness.
situation: Your professor has announced that next week's midterm exam will be moved from Thursday afternoon to Saturday morning. You work a fixed shift every Saturday morning and cannot change it on short notice. You would like to take the exam at a different time.
must_include: 土曜日に受験できない理由
